description: Hand-labeled reference subset for judge calibration. The automated faithfulness/relevance judges run against the REFERENCE answer using the gold section context and are compared to the human verdict. Two fabricated answers (f01/f02) verify the judge flags unsupported content.

labels.question: How many days of annual leave do employees accrue per year?
labels.reference_answer: Employees accrue 25 working days of annual leave per year.

labels.question: How long is the probation period for new hires?
labels.reference_answer: New hires serve a 90-day probation period.

labels.question: How many days per week can an employee work remotely after probation?
labels.reference_answer: Employees may work remotely up to three days per week after completing probation.

labels.question: How much notice is required when an individual contributor resigns?
labels.reference_answer: Individual contributors must give 30 days of notice.

labels.question: What severity classification applies to a data breach or production outage?
labels.reference_answer: A data breach or production outage is classified as SEV-1.

labels.question: Is multi-factor authentication required for accounts with access to production data?
labels.reference_answer: Yes, MFA is mandatory for all accounts with access to production data.

labels.question: How long is customer personal information retained after the service contract ends?
labels.reference_answer: Customer personal information is retained for the contract duration plus 12 months.

labels.question: How quickly must a suspected breach of the security policy be reported?
labels.reference_answer: A suspected breach must be reported to security-oncall within one hour.

labels.question: Can an employee who is still in probation work remotely, and how many days?
labels.reference_answer: No; remote work is only available after the probation period is completed.

labels.question: During a SEV-1 incident, how often must status be updated and who owns the incident?
labels.reference_answer: SEV-1 incidents require a status update every 30 minutes and an Incident Commander.

labels.question: An employee works remotely on a personal device. Is that compliant with policy?
labels.reference_answer: No; remote access requires a managed device, the approved VPN, and MFA.

labels.question: Can employees work remotely?
labels.reference_answer: Yes, but only after probation, up to three days per week, logged 48 hours ahead.

labels.question: How quickly are security incidents resolved?
labels.reference_answer: The documentation does not define a resolution time; SEV-1 requires status updates every 30 minutes.

labels.question: How long is data retained?
labels.reference_answer: Retention depends on data class; customer personal information is kept for the contract duration plus 12 months.

labels.question: How many days of annual leave do employees accrue per year?
labels.reference_answer: Employees accrue 40 days of annual leave, and no carryover is permitted.
labels.note: FABRICATED: contradicts the handbook (25 days, 10-day carryover)

labels.question: What severity applies to a production outage?
labels.reference_answer: A production outage is classified as SEV-4 and requires no incident commander.
labels.note: FABRICATED: SEV-4 does not exist; outages are SEV-1
